title.zh: BTCPay Tells Merchants to Switch Off Servers Amid Hot Wallet Attack Reports
title.en: BTCPay Tells Merchants to Switch Off Servers Amid Hot Wallet Attack Reports

current_state.zh: BTCPay Server told operators to shut down their instances after reports that attackers were draining hot wallets on servers running versions 2.4.1 or older, following an emergency 2.4.7 release that fixed a critical vulnerability discovered by Anthropic's scanner.
current_state.en: BTCPay Server told operators to shut down their instances after reports that attackers were draining hot wallets on servers running versions 2.4.1 or older, following an emergency 2.4.7 release that fixed a critical vulnerability discovered by Anthropic's scanner.
